# Hanvi Events

Hanvi Events is an event management and luxury wedding planning studio based in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Contact & Studio

- Website: https://www.hanvievents.com
- Studio: 1st Floor, Subhamasthu Showroom, D.No: 20-11-40, Majestic Street, Suryanarayana Puram, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh 533001, India
- Phone: +91 97009 29650
- WhatsApp: +91 63054 57612
- Email: hello@hanvievents.com

## Leadership & Service Verticals

- Lead: Ch. Kala Prasad, Founder & Event Director
- Core Verticals: Luxury Telugu Wedding Planning, Vedic Mandap Architecture, Milestone 1st Birthdays, Barasala Cradle Ceremonies, Half Saree Functions, and Corporate Stage & AV Production.
- Service Areas: Kakinada (HQ Hub), Rajahmundry (Rajamahendravaram), Samalkota, Pithapuram, Amalapuram, Mandapeta, Peddapuram, and the entire East Godavari district.
